title: Now Live: Vendor Invites
summary: Vendor onboarding just got a lot easier. Hop onto your Slash dashboard and check it out today.
body_markdown:
## Collect vendor details securely with less back-and-forth


Getting a vendor ready to pay often means chasing bank details, mailing addresses, and tax forms across long email threads. Now, you can request the details you need through Slash and let recipients submit their information securely in one place.


With vendor information requests, you can invite a new recipient or request updated details from an existing one. Choose whether to collect payment details, an address, tax information, or any combination. You can also add a personal note and preview the email and request page before sending.


Your recipient receives a secure link where they can sign in, provide the requested information, and submit it directly to your Slash account.¹


## Collect the right payment details


Choose which payment methods you’re prepared to accept, including:


- US bank accounts
- International bank accounts
- Stablecoin wallets⁴


Recipients only see the options you selected, helping you collect compatible payout details the first time.


## Simplify tax document collection


When tax information is requested, recipients can upload a W-9 or W-8 document as a PDF or image. Slash extracts the information it recognizes to help prefill the form, while allowing the recipient to review and complete the required details before submitting.


## Stay up to date without the follow-up


Slash tracks pending requests from the recipient page, where you can copy the request link or cancel it if it’s no longer needed. Once the recipient submits their details, you’ll receive an email letting you know they’re ready for review.


Recipients can return to the request page to update their details, helping you avoid exchanging sensitive information over email.


### Vendor information requests are now available in your Slash dashboard.


To get started, go to **Payments → Recipients** . Open an existing recipient and select **Request information** , or select **New recipient** , then **Invite recipient** to invite someone new.
